parsed.post: New best! DEPTH=8 with MATRIX_LR=0.03 yielded 0.9827. This confirms that depth increases are beneficial if the learning rate is sufficiently moderated. I'm now going to try increasing the weight decay to see if better regularization can further improve the validation loss.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.01 to 0.05 to improve generalization and prevent overfitting as we maximize model capacity with DEPTH=8.
